mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a financial crisis.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in UNRATE below 3.5% coincident with a fall in PAYEMS signals weakening labor demand, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a technology-led market rally.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in GDPC1 for three consecutive quarters indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for three consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly different from zero during such episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% signals improving industrial production, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent fall in both GDPC1 and HOUST below their 6-month moving averages signals a broad-based decline in housing and overall demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% during a recession signals an aggressive easing cycle, which supports risk assets and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly above zero during such episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDPC1 and RSAFS above their 3-month moving averages indicates strengthening aggregate demand and corporate liquidity, which supports higher equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly above zero in at least 70% of triggered episodes.
